{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "# This is a basic workflow that is manually triggered

name: Compilation and Format Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Format & Shader Checks
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: echo "VERSION=$(grep -i \"minimum_zig_version\" build.zig.zon | cut -d'\"' -f2)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2
        with:
          version: ${{ env.VERSION }}
      - run: sudo apt install glslang-tools
      - name: Cache Cubyz-fmt
        id: cache-cubyz-fmt
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./Cubyz-fmt
          key: cubyz-fmt-0.17.0
      - name: Download Cubyz-fmt
        if: steps.cache-cubyz-fmt.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: wget -O ./Cubyz-fmt https://github.com/PixelGuys/Cubyz-formatter/releases/download/0.17.0+0/Cubyz-fmt-x86_64-linux
      - name: Ensure Cubyz-fmt executable
        if: steps.cache-cubyz-fmt.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: chmod +x ./Cubyz-fmt
      - name: Cache Cubyz-linter
        id: cache-cubyz-linter
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./Cubyz-linter
          key: cubyz-linter-0.17.0
      - name: Download Cubyz-linter
        if: steps.cache-cubyz-linter.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: wget -O ./Cubyz-linter https://github.com/PixelGuys/Cubyz-linter/releases/download/0.17.0+2/Cubyz-linter-x86_64-linux
      - name: Ensure Cubyz-linter executable
        if: steps.cache-cubyz-linter.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: chmod +x ./Cubyz-linter
      - run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          for file in *.zon assets/*.zon assets/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*.zon assets/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*/*.zon ; do
            zig ast-check $file
          done
      - run: |
          if ./Cubyz-fmt assets/ mods/ src/ *.zig *.zon | grep -q . ; then
            git diff --color=always;
            exit 1;
          fi
      - run: ./Cubyz-linter assets/ mods/ src/ *.zon
      - run: 'find assets/cubyz/shaders -type f ! -name "*.glsl" | xargs -L1 glslangValidator -G100 -P"#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : enable" -Iassets/cubyz/shaders/include -Dgl_VertexIndex=gl_VertexID -DOPEN_GL'

  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
      fail-fast: true
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: Build & Test (${{ matrix.os }})
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: echo "VERSION=$(grep -i \"minimum_zig_version\" build.zig.zon | cut -d'\"' -f2)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2
        with:
          version: ${{ env.VERSION }}
      - run: zig build
      - if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
        run: zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-native
      - if: matrix.os != 'macos-latest'
        run: zig build -Dtarget=aarch64-native-gnu
      - run: zig build test", "rationale": "Added concurrency to cancel superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), added job timeouts based on historical run durations (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), and added caching for downloaded formatter and linter binaries (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). All changes preserve build and test coverage.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-ca499b3aaef0d029", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
